name: Prometheus (host metrics)
author: Netlens
description: Reads the processor, memory, swap, disks, network traffic, load and uptime of hosts from a Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir or Thanos that already scrapes them (node_exporter for Linux, BSD and macOS; windows_exporter for Windows), so a host that cannot be probed needs no second agent. The store's own history fills the graphs. Read-only: only GET requests to /api/v1; nothing is sent to the hosts.

info.title: What it reads
info.text: Hosts are matched to the devices Netlens knows by IP address, then MAC address, then name. A device that is monitored another way (SNMP, SSH, WinRM, a host agent) is left alone. Use a read-only user or token on the Prometheus side: the plugin only needs /api/v1/query and /api/v1/query_range.

config.label: Prometheus
config.help: The address of a Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir or Thanos Query (HTTPS is assumed when you leave the scheme out). A path prefix is allowed (https://example.com/prometheus).

columns.label: Certificate fingerprint
columns.help: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's certificate. When filled in, exactly that certificate is trusted (also a self-signed one).

config.label: Only these jobs
config.help: Leave empty to read every host. Otherwise a comma separated list of Prometheus job names (letters, digits and _ . : - only).

config.label: History to take over (minutes)
config.help: Each sync also takes the store's own readings of the last minutes, so graphs are as dense as the store's even when Netlens syncs rarely. 0 reads only the newest value. Should be longer than the time between syncs.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Turn off for a self-signed certificate. Better: fill in the certificate fingerprint.

config.label: Allow plain http
config.help: Off: an address that starts with http:// is refused, because a token or password would cross the network unencrypted. Turn on only for a lab or a store on the same machine.
